messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: anomalous cross-region routing detected — high tail latency for apac->eu traffic, surge starting 02:00 UTC. Autoscale unaffected, customer error rate rising.

liz_oncall: I'm on it. confirming which routes/policies firing now.

ryan_net: Seeing steady 5xxs and 2-3s tails from apac->eu-west. Traffic abruptly shifted to eu-west2 even though latency steer should prefer apac-edge. Metrics: steering-weight signal shows eu-west weight bumped.

ash_sre: Can you paste the policy eval output? suspect policy evaluation fallback.

ryan_net: Pasting snippet from router logs:
```
[2026-03-17T02:00:05Z] route-eval id=abc123 src=apac->client dst=eu-west2 policy=latency-steer result=matched(reason=cache-stale)
[2026-03-17T02:00:05Z] apply-route id=abc123 weight=1.0 pinned=true
```

jordan_eng: Wait — pinned=true. We recently deployed a pinning change to prefer region affinity for some customers. Could be interacting with steering fallback.

maya_cs: We have 8 customers on support pages reporting timeouts for APAC users hitting EU-resident models. CS is triaging high-value customers, sending status.

dave_platform: Checking control-plane logs — there was a partial config propagation to edge-routers at 01:58 UTC. A race where regional pin state RPCs were replayed after a rollback.

liz_oncall: Immediate mitigation options? suggestion: revoke pins for affected routes, force regional-fallback for apac traffic, and increase probe frequency. Who can patch routing policy quickly?

jordan_eng: I can push a targeted policy override to the steering controller to disable pin enforcement for the apac->eu steering group. Patch below:
```yaml
steering_group: apac->eu
pin_enforcement: false  # emergency override
apply_mode: immediate
```

ops-bot: change-request submitted by jordan_eng — id=chg-742. Approve? :robot_face:

ash_sre: Approving. Ash signing off to avoid rollback surprises.

liz_oncall: Approved. jordan, apply and monitor. ash, watch for cascades.

ops-bot: change chg-742 applied at 02:04:12 UTC to steering-controller (diff=3 lines).

ryan_net: I see traffic rebalancing back to apac-edge, tail latency dropping. 1min post-change: 95th p99 tail down from 2.9s -> 0.4s. Error rate trending down.

maya_cs: Notified customers: ETA 10m for resolution, updating tickets.

liz_oncall: Great. Next step: roll a cleanup to ensure pins don't replay on agent reconnect. Dave, can you add guard to replay logic?

dave_platform: Yep, adding idempotency check to pin-replay RPCs and a short TTL to pinned-state on control-plane. Will open a PR and hotfix after incident window.

jordan_eng: Also adding unit test for policy+pin interaction.

ash_sre: Recommend post-incident: run a targeted eval across steering groups to detect stale pin states and add alert when pin toggles exceed threshold.

liz_oncall: Confirming customers are seeing improvement. Maya, any lingering major customer impact?

maya_cs: Two high-touch customers reported intermittent errors during window but now stable. They want a follow-up postmortem and timeline.

incident-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 -> mitigated. Timeline recorded. Pager cleared for now.

liz_oncall: I'll hand this to runbook-owner to make a follow-up. Opening incident doc and assigning owners: postmortem=liz_oncall, platform-fix=dave_platform, policy-tests=jordan_eng, cs-followup=maya_cs.

dave_platform: grabbing the ticket. will include rollback race logs and a patch plan.

ryan_net: Leaving a note: if you see pin=true in route-eval logs during a traffic shift, treat as high-priority.

liz_oncall: Thanks team. Closing thread when postmortem link is added. :thumbsup:
